title: Geometry of the graph chart G(v) = x + ιv + u(v): C² immersion, injectivity, compact preimages, S ∩ Z = G(D ∩ G⁻¹S), Borel preimages
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (u : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u (ball 0 δ₁) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, ∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) (u v) = 0) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, ‖u v‖ < δ₂ / 2) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, x + ι v + u v ∈ N) → (∀ (v : Euclid (n + 1)) (h : Euclid P), ‖v‖ < δ₁ → ‖h‖ < δ₂ → (∀ w : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (ι w) h = 0) → x + ι v + h ∈ N → h = u v) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => x + ι y + u y) (ball 0 δ₁) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, ∀ a : Euclid (n + 1), fderiv ℝ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) v a = ι a + fderiv ℝ u v a) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid (n + 1)) δ₁, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) v)) ∧ InjOn (fun y => x + ι y + u y) (ball 0 δ₁) ∧ IsOpen {w : Euclid P | ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x)‖ < δ₁ ∧ ‖w - x - ι (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x))‖ < δ₂} ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ {w : Euclid P | ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x)‖ < δ₁ ∧ ‖w - x - ι (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x))‖ < δ₂} → IsCompact (ball 0 δ₁ ∩ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) ⁻¹' K)) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Euclid P), S ⊆ N → S ∩ {w : Euclid P | ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x)‖ < δ₁ ∧ ‖w - x - ι (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap (w - x))‖ < δ₂} = (fun y => x + ι y + u y) '' (ball 0 δ₁ ∩ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) ⁻¹' S)) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → MeasurableSet (ball 0 δ₁ ∩ (fun y => x + ι y + u y) ⁻¹' S)
